prompts.panel: Create a production raster UI skin asset for Waymark, matching the attached reference's blackened leather/stone texture and worn antique brass borders. Reference image is STYLE ONLY. Output a single empty rectangular panel, landscape 1536x1024, straight-on orthographic view, fills entire canvas to edges. Thin distressed antique brass double-line border at the very edges with delicate engraved gothic metal corner fittings within 40 pixels of each corner. Center is near-black charcoal leather with subtle mottled fine grain, faint diagonal wear and soft uneven shading; visibly textured but dark enough for ivory text. NO text, NO icons, NO controls, NO divisions, NO logo, NO perspective, NO outside margin, NO drop shadow outside canvas. This actual image will be used as the application's resizable nine-slice background, so keep border very thin and center almost uniform in darkness. Restrained craftsmanship exactly like the reference, not bright gold or extravagant fantasy ornament.
prompts.controls: Production sprite atlas for a compact gothic desktop UI called Waymark. Style reference attached: blackened leather, muted antique brass, restrained aged craftsmanship. EXACT grid: image 1536 wide by 1024 tall; 3 columns and 4 rows of equally sized cells (512x256). Each cell is filled completely by its asset, no gutters or text labels. Row 1: three empty rectangular button backgrounds normal, hover, pressed; thin worn brass border at cell edge, dark textured charcoal center, hover muted warm brown, pressed darker inset. Row 2: three empty selection-row backgrounds inactive, selected, hover; black leather with very thin aged brass horizontal borders, selected restrained umber glow and left brass accent. Row 3: three empty input-field backgrounds normal, focused, disabled; thin inset bronze edges and black textured centers. Row 4: three empty tab backgrounds normal, selected, hover; restrained thin worn brass edge. Corners on controls simple subtly beveled, not elaborate. NO WORDS, LETTERS, NUMBERS, ICONS, SYMBOLS, no rounded modern pill shapes, no neon, no drop shadows outside cells. Artwork should fit edge-to-edge in each exact grid cell for automated extraction. All have texture visible but quiet. These are actual interactive widget skins not a mockup.
prompts.icons: Production UI icon sprite sheet, transparent background. EXACT 4 columns x 3 rows equal square grid in a 1024x768 image. Each icon centered in its cell, approximately 150x150 within 256x256 cell. All same muted antique brass and warm ivory, subtly worn engraved metal, legible silhouettes matching a restrained dark gothic Path of Exile companion program. Row 1 left to right: four-tile modules icon, blacksmith anvil workshop icon, parchment scroll history icon, magnifying glass search icon. Row 2: folded parchment map icon, two right-facing route chevrons, skull monster icon, hanging bell alert icon. Row 3: small treasure chest icon, flame hazard icon, hourglass uptime icon, mechanical cog settings icon. NO words, no labels, no border grid, no cell backgrounds, no glow, no colorful gems. Use coherent chunky engraved silhouettes with slight metallic relief instead of thin generic outline icons. Transparent background.
